response.note: Median amount_inr of successful attempts at NovaMart from 18 Oct through 31 Oct 2026; assumes the success status value is 'SUCCESS' and merchant_name is exactly 'NovaMart'.
response.sql: SELECT median(amount_inr) AS median_amount_inr FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE merchant_name = 'NovaMart' AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
